traits.description: Descriptive traits only. A platform-originated person may have no email, password or OIDC credential, so no trait carries an ory.sh/kratos extension and nothing here is ownership evidence: bindings and grants live in Nora's binding store and Keto, not in mutable traits.

display_name.description: The person's display name. Descriptive, never matchable.

social.description: The social-memory opt-out. false excludes the person's social records from memory reads. Descriptive state only — ownership and grants stay in Nora's binding store and Keto — and an absent or malformed value reads as unavailable, never inferred enabled.

labels.description: Operator-authored descriptive labels. Readable metadata, never matchable and never ownership evidence.
